declarations.title: Who I am
declarations.text: {name} is fearfully and wonderfully made. {name} is God's workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, together with all God's people. The LORD who redeemed Israel calls His own by name.
declarations.firstPersonText: I am fearfully and wonderfully made. With all God's people, I am His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works. The LORD who redeemed Israel calls His own by name.
declarations.groundingNote: EPH 2:10, ISA 43:1 were first spoken to God's people corporately. This declaration receives what the passage reveals about God; it is not a private guarantee.
